From: Emma Kelly <emma.kelly@zenora.health>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood Inference invoices

Hi Olga,

Hope youre well. Were starting the vendor setup in our AP system so we can issue POs for the upcoming proof-of-concept work with Redwood. Can you send over your AP onboarding packet and confirm the following so we can create your vendor record: 

- Correct legal name and remit-to address for taxes/TIN/VAT
- Bank/payment method options and whether you accept ACH/EU SEPA
- Any required invoice fields (must include customer PO number? project code?)
- Your VAT / tax ID and whether you invoice gross or net (were in DE; want to know if reverse-charge applies)

If you already have a vendor packet or sample invoice we can use to seed the record, please attach. Would like to get this completed by end of week to issue a PO next week.

Thanks,
Emma Kelly
AP Lead, Zenora Health
emma.kelly@zenora.health
ap@zenora.health

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Emma Kelly <emma.kelly@zenora.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-02T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood Inference invoices

Emma,

Thanks for the quick note — attaching our standard AP onboarding packet and a short checklist. Key points up front:

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit-to (for bank transfer): Redwood Inference, Inc., 1107 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103 (we will collect EU bank details if you require EUR payouts)
- Invoice requirements: include Zenora PO number on the invoice (exact PO string in the "Invoice reference" field), invoice date, line-level unit price, net and VAT amounts broken out, and our company VAT/TIN
- VAT handling: we can invoice gross if you prefer, but if youre doing reverse-charge please include your VAT number and add the phrase "reverse charge - Article 194" on the invoice line
- Payment terms: standard is Net 30 from invoice receipt against an issued PO (we can negotiate for specific contract terms)

Attachments: olga_vendor_onboarding_packet_v3.pdf (vendor questionnaire + required fields).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Complete the packet and return with your VAT certificate/TIN.
2) Well create a vendor record and return a Redwood vendor id (for your routing).
3) Once the PO is issued, submit invoice referencing the PO and vendor id.

Looping in Laura (Finance Ops) and Karthik (Contracts) to help with any special PO field mapping — Laura, can you confirm whether we require a HubSpot deal id on the invoice for reconciliation?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Attachment: olga_vendor_onboarding_packet_v3.pdf

From: Emma Kelly <emma.kelly@zenora.health>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Zenora AP <ap@zenora.health>
Date: 2027-02-03T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood Inference invoices

Thanks Olga — quick clarifications before we submit the vendor form: 

- Our AP system requires a separate "PO_LINE_ID" field on invoices when POs have multiple line items. Can Redwood accept a PO line identifier on each invoice line?
- Do you require a customer-side PO (Zenora PO) or an internal Redwood PO on the invoice for reconciliation? Our process prefers the customer PO (Zenora PO) in the invoice reference.
- VAT: Ive attached our VAT certificate; we do not want VAT charged if the reverse charge applies. Please confirm the exact wording you need on the invoice to process as reverse charge.

Attaching: zenora_vat_certificate.pdf

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood requires a W-9 / US tax form for non-US vendors?

Emma

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Emma Kelly <emma.kelly@zenora.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karik_iyer@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-04T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO requirements for Redwood Inference invoices

Emma / Zenora AP,

Great, thanks for the certificate — weve reviewed. Answers below and a sample invoice template attached.

- PO_LINE_ID: yes, we can accept a PO_LINE_ID per line. Please put it in the invoice line description and as a separate column labeled PO_LINE_ID so our parser can pick it up.
- Invoice reference: please use the Zenora PO number (the PO well reference on our side is the customer PO); include it in the top-level "Reference" field and on each line if applicable.
- Reverse charge wording: include your VAT number on the invoice and add the text "Reverse charge - Article 194 (VAT not charged)" on either the invoice footer or the VAT line. That ensures our accounting team treats the invoice correctly.
- W-9: not required for EU vendors. We only request US tax forms for contractors or US-based vendors.

Attached: sample_invoice_redwood_template.xlsx (example with PO, PO_LINE_ID, net/vat split).

Operational items: once you return the completed packet and your bank details, we will:
1) Create a vendor record and assign Redwood vendor id (Ill send that back)
2) Link the vendor record to the HubSpot deal (ZEN-2027-0042) for reconciliation
3) Provide expected payment timing (Net 30 from invoice receipt against PO).

Marcus Lin (ccd) will be the point for payment exceptions or payment schedule requests. Marcus, can you confirm whether we can support SEPA transfers for Zenora?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Attachments: sample_invoice_redwood_template.xlsx
